card.statement:
(1)

Recall the setting of Proposition 4.8, and assume that the map $S\to\mathrm{Bun}_{T}$ factors through a map $S\to\mathrm{Bun}_{T}^{\lambda}$. Then we have

$S\times_{\mathrm{Bun}_{T},p_{1}}\mathbf{Z}^{\mu}=S\times_{\mathrm{Bun}_{T}^{\lambda},p_{1}}\mathbf{Z}^{\mu}_{\lambda}=\bigsqcup_{0\preceq\nu\preceq\mu}S\times_{\mathrm{Bun}_{T}^{\lambda},p_{1}}{}_{\nu}\mathbf{Z}^{\mu}_{\lambda}.$

By (4.24) we also have

$S\times\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}=\bigsqcup_{0\preceq\nu\preceq\mu}S\times{}_{\nu}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}.$

It is clear from the proof of that proposition that the local isomorphisms between $S\times_{\mathrm{Bun}_{T},p_{1}}\mathbf{Z}^{\mu}$ and $S\times\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}$ constructed in that proof identify the intersection with $S\times_{\mathrm{Bun}_{T}^{\lambda},p_{1}}{}_{\nu}\mathbf{Z}^{\mu}_{\lambda}$ with the intersection with $S\times{}_{\nu}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}$, for any $\nu$ such that $0\preceq\nu\preceq\mu$. A similar claim holds for the decompositions (4.20) and (4.25).

(2)

The stratum ${}_{\nu}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}$ is denoted ${}_{\nu}Z^{\mu}$ in [10, §3.5]. (In case $\nu=0$, the notation $Z^{\mu}_{\max}$ is also used for ${}_{0}Z^{\mu}$.) In [17, §3.6.1], the open subscheme ${}_{0}\overline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}\subset\overline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}$ is denoted $\mathring{\mathscr{Z}}^{-\mu}$.

In (4.21), choosing $\lambda=0$ and taking the fiber product with $\{\mathcal{F}^{0}\}$ over $\mathrm{Bun}_{T}$ (for $p_{1}$ ), we deduce an isomorphism

${}_{\nu}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}\cong C^{\nu}\times{}_{0}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu-\nu},$

see [10, §3.5]. For any $\Gamma\in\mathfrak{P}(\nu)$, this isomorphism restricts to an isomorphism

(4.26)

${}_{\Gamma}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}\cong C^{\nu}_{\Gamma}\times{}_{0}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu-\nu}.$

(These statements do not have counterparts for the scheme $\overline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}$.)
card.label: Remark 4.14

paper.title: Modular intersection cohomology of Drinfeld's compactifications
paper.abstract: We compute the dimension of the cohomology of stalks of intersection cohomology complexes on Zastava schemes and Drinfeld compactifications associated with a connected reductive algebraic group $G$, in case the characteristic of the coefficients field $\Bbbk$ is good for $G$. In particular, we show that these dimensions do not depend on the choice of $\Bbbk$.
